profit_quality.assessment: Operating cash flow supports reported profit over three years, but 2024 cash conversion weakened as contract liabilities fell and bills receivables increased. The denominator uses normalized parent profit, strips treasury/one-off components and applies a 0.75 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Started from three-year parent net profit median of RMB64.092 million.
Excluded or haircut bank interest income because stripped surplus cash should not keep earning as operating-business profit.
Reduced for land resumption gains, weaker recurring quality of government rewards and maintenance capex.
Included RMB5.0 million working-capital reinvestment reserve for bills receivable growth and contract-liability release.
Used RMB47.0 million pre-haircut distributable cash profit and 0.75 profit haircut.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Three-year operating cash flow was RMB100.058 million, RMB89.535 million and RMB76.885 million versus parent net profit of RMB64.092 million, RMB59.140 million and RMB65.623 million.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Stable port-service profit and strong historical OCF support a relatively high factor, but China onshore cash, customer deposits, lower 2024 OCF, government/tax preference reliance and ongoing port asset maintenance prevent using 0.90-1.00.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: OCF/parent net profit using three-year sums is about 1.36x, but 2024 alone fell to about 1.17x.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; 2024 PPE additions of RMB5.743 million are used as proxy.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 working capital used cash mainly through RMB15.899 million contract-liability decline and RMB8.527 million increase in bank acceptance bills.
